card.name: Adding words and fraction slashes
card.fires_on: Words meaning to add or combine (Add, adding, added, plus) and the slash in mixed fractions like 1-1/2. Also fires on the end of petechiae and on 'or' between drug names.

modes.label: Add/plus verbs
modes.description: Verbs or words meaning to add or combine one thing with another.
modes.example: Start with net income. <<Add>> back non-cash expenses.

modes.label: Fraction slash
modes.description: The slash inside a mixed number such as 1-1/2 or 16 1/8.

modes.description: The end of petechiae, or 'or' linking two drug names.
